text:
kevin: Quick Q — support keeps asking what POST /configs/preview does vs apply. Can we lock the contract and minimal telemetry?

marta: Console currently shows a diff + route simulation but we don't surface a preview_id. Support needs an auditable handle.

dyson: Strong +1 that preview must never emit production SLO metrics. It should be a read-only dry-run: write an audit entry and emit sampled telemetry (default 1%). Force full logging for sensitive keys.

laura: API sketch: POST /v1/configs/preview -> { preview_id, diff, routeSimulation, warnings } and return preview_id in the response header and body so console and logs can correlate.

ankur: Add header semantics: X-Config-Mode: preview|preflight|apply. Preflight = run simulator synchronously (5s timeout) and return 409 with details if constraints or capacity checks fail. No side-effects on routing metrics.

marta: Console UX: show a persistent "PREVIEW (not applied)" pill with preview_id + link to audit, and a "Promote to canary" action that preserves the exact delta/cohort. Also show estimated cost/QPS impact.

dyson: We'll add a lightweight capacity guard in preflight that compares expected qps to pool_capacity * headroom. If it fails, return remediation steps (increase pool, enable fallback routing).

kevin: OK action items: laura docs API + preview_id placement; dyson/ankur implement audit events + sampled telemetry + sensitive escalation + preflight capacity guard; marta/ryan mock console flows and "promote" behavior.

ops-bot: Reminder: next config deploy window Tue 02:00 UTC. Preflights must complete before window to be included.
